| description = Alternative way to obtain the Red Dragon Scale. Procs Deadly Lifetap (1500hp frontal lifetap, same as VS).  Boon of the Garou proc and lifetaps were resisted; possibly immune to lifetaps.  Sunstrike and other wizard nukes landed, concussion resisted.  Shaman ice nukes land as well.  Runs at low hp.

Strategy:  Fight him just like you fight [[Venril Sathir]].

Nortlav is indifferent to all, but '''will''' social with nearby mobs.

'''NOTE:''' During the classic era there were rumors that Nortlav could drop other scales.  Those rumors are discussed/debunked in [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=406654 this thread].
